commands.source: Check out the verification bot's source code
commands.postverify: Post the TVM verification button in this channel
commands.testmail: Send a test verification email through Resend

commands.audit: View recent member list updates and account transfers

modals.emailLabel: Email you signed up to TVM with

verification.invalidEmail: That email doesn't look right. Check it and try again!
verification.unavailable: Verification is unavailable right now. Please reach out to the TVM Admin Team for help.
verification.rateLimited: You've requested a code recently. Give it a moment before trying again!
verification.codeSent: If this email is on the TVM member list, you'll receive a verification code. Check your inbox and junk folder, then enter it below!
verification.emailFailed: We couldn't send your verification email. Try again later or reach out to the TVM Admin Team.
verification.invalidCodeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from your verification email.
verification.alreadyClaimed: This email is already linked to another Discord account. Reach out to the TVM Admin Team to move your membership to this account.
verification.invalidCode: That code is incorrect or has expired. Check it or request a new one!
verification.roleFailed: Your code was accepted, but we couldn't confirm your Discord roles. Reach out to the TVM Admin Team to get this sorted.
verification.complete: You're verified! Your TVM membership gives you access to {roles}. Welcome in! 🎉
verification.post:
Welcome to the TVM Discord! 🎥

Click the button below to verify using the email you signed up to TVM with. We'll send you a code to enter here!

Once verified, you'll receive {memberRole} and get access to the member channels. Producers and editors also receive {execRole}, and admins also receive {adminRole}.

Check your junk folder if the email doesn't show up! If you need help, reach out to the TVM Admin Team.
verification.source: Check out the bot's source code: https://github.com/TheTexta/tvm-discord-email-verification
verification.failed: Something went wrong. Please reach out to the TVM Admin Team so they can check the bot logs and try again.

email.codeBody:
Hey!

Your TVM Discord verification code is {code}.

Enter it in Discord to verify your membership and access the TVM member channels. This code expires in 15 minutes.

If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email!

TVM
email.testBody:
Hey!

This is a test email from the TVM Discord verification bot.

If you're reading this, the test email reached your inbox!

admin.permissionRequired: You'll need the Admin Team role or Discord Administrator permission to use this command.
admin.uploadComplete: Uploaded {uploaded} rows! The active member list now has {count} emails (version {version}). Existing roles were kept. Membership links needing a role sync retry: {failed}.
admin.status: Active member list: {count} members (version {version}). Removals still needing reconciliation: {unreconciled}.
admin.noRoster: There's no active TVM member list yet. Verification is closed.
admin.noAudit: No member list updates or account transfers recorded yet.
admin.reconciled: Role sync complete! Roles revoked: {revoked}. Membership links needing a role sync retry: {failed}. Unverified roles added: {added}, removed: {removed}, failed: {unverifiedFailed}.
admin.released: Unlinked the verified membership for <@{userId}>. They can verify again if they're on the active member list.
admin.testmailSent: SMTP accepted the test email! Check the recipient's inbox and junk folder to confirm it arrived.

alerts.emailFailed: Couldn't send a verification email. Check Resend and the bot logs.

alerts.unverifiedSync: {failed} member(s) still need their Unverified role synced. Run /roster reconcile.
alerts.claimSync: {failed} verified membership link(s) still need their roles synced. Run /roster reconcile.
alerts.transferFailed: The membership was transferred, but the new account's role couldn't be confirmed. Check permissions, then use /roster repair.
alerts.startupFailed: Bot startup or member list reconciliation failed. Check the bot logs.
alerts.unverifiedFailed: Couldn't assign the Unverified role. Check the bot's permissions, then run /roster reconcile.
alerts.interactionFailed: Something went wrong during a member's verification. Check the bot logs.

shoot.command: Create and manage TVM shoot chats
shoot.setup: Create a private shoot chat and publish its invitation
shoot.edit: Edit shoot details and the reaction joining window
shoot.close: Archive this shoot as read-only for participants
shoot.reopen: Reopen this shoot chat with its existing joining deadline
shoot.membersOption: Optional @mentions of verified members to invite immediately
shoot.permission: You need the Admin Team role or Discord Administrator permission to manage shoots.
shoot.disabled: Shoot chats are not configured on this server.
shoot.notText: Run this command in a server text channel.
shoot.notShoot: This channel is not a TVM-managed shoot chat.
shoot.expired: This setup or edit form has expired or changed. Run the command again.
shoot.mentions: Enter only Discord user @mentions, separated by spaces or commas (up to 70 members).
shoot.ineligible: <@{userId}> must be a verified TVM member, an Admin Team member, or a Discord administrator, and cannot be a bot.
shoot.invalidTime: Enter a valid date as YYYY-MM-DD and time as HH:mm in Toronto. Leave the time blank for noon, or the date blank for an unscheduled shoot. Daylight-saving gaps and repeated times are not accepted.
shoot.invalidDetails: Enter a shoot name (up to 100 characters) and location (up to 200 characters).
shoot.closedReply: Shoot archived. Existing participants can still read it.
shoot.pending: This shoot is still being synchronized. Try again shortly; admins have been alerted.
shoot.configError: Shoot configuration is invalid or the bot is missing required permissions.
shoot.missingChannel: The shoot channel was deleted or moved to another server. It will not be recreated automatically.
shoot.full: This shoot has reached its participant limit. A member must leave before more people can join.
shoot.joinDenied: You could not join this shoot. Joining may have expired, or the shoot may be closed, full, or require an active TVM verification. Ask an admin to add you with /shoot add.
shoot.invitation: React 🎬 to join; remove your reaction to leave. Verified TVM members and administrators can join.
shoot.closedInvitation: This shoot is closed. New joins are disabled; existing participants can read the archive.
shoot.add: Add a verified member to this shoot, including after reaction joining expires
shoot.addUserOption: Verified member or administrator to add to the shoot
shoot.added: Added <@{userId}> to this shoot. Removing their reaction will not remove their access.
shoot.addOpenOnly: Reopen this shoot before adding members.
shoot.joinDescription: Starts when the invitation is first published; month means 30 days.
shoot.invalidJoinPeriod: Choose 1 day, 2 days, week, month, or never for the reaction joining window.
shoot.expiredInvitation: Reaction joining has expired. The shoot chat remains open; ask an admin to add you with /shoot add. Existing members can remove their reaction to leave.
shoot.directInvitesMore: {count} more direct invitations; admins can view the full list with /shoot crew.
